mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 5.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% in the prior 3 months signals strengthening manufacturing supply chains, supporting corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% in prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 per month signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicate severe economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates active monetary tightening, which typically reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
